info.title: BlindSpot API
info.description: Current Flask API. Health is implemented; legacy POST operations return placeholder responses and newer operations return HTTP 501. Authentication, ownership checks, persistence, execution, and SSE are not implemented. Parameters marked as planned describe the intended contract and are not currently validated. See docs/frontend-api-design.md.
